newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberdrola says dividend covered by profit.
newsitem.headline: Iberdrola says dividend covered by profit.

text.p: Spain's Iberdrola does not need to dip into reserves to pay its shareholder dividend although it has comfortable reserves of 77 billion pesetas, a company spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.
"It won't be necessary to use reserves to pay the dividend," the spokesman said.
At a news conference on Wednesday before the annual shareholders meeting, Iberdrola Chairman Inigo de Oriol said the company has 77 billion pesetas in reserves to guarantee shareholder remuneration.
The shareholder meeting on Saturday will approve, in addition to a gross dividend of 70 pesetas, the amortisation of two percent of its treasury stock, half of which was amortised in December.
